image: A low stone curb cut into three stacked, rounded steps running down the left edge of a hillside road — the terraced 'village/mound' radical seen leaning against whatever stands beside it.
A hasty topknot of hair tied above a small child's head, one strand escaping and trailing down over the crown — the loose, flowing shape sitting at the top of the glyph.
Two identical tin camping cups stacked mouth-to-base under a peaked lid, nested so tightly they look like one doubled block.
A single metal hairpin bent sharply at the knee into an L-hook, lying tucked into the corner of a drawer, ready to snag anything that brushes past it.
A small pair of stubby deer antlers, broken short and splayed outward like two flattened horns capping whatever sits underneath them.
A wooden shipping crate divided into three horizontal shelves stacked inside its frame, each shelf-line showing through the front slats like a little ladder of boxes.
A single wilted plant stalk bending over at the top, its stem drooping down and curling under from lack of water, no leaves left.
A single crooked stitch of thread yanked through cloth in a hurry, the needle's diagonal jab crossing the vertical seam before the tailor rushes off.
A thin triangular pennant on a short pole, snapping sideways in the wind with two loose cords whipping out beneath it.
A fish's tail caught mid-flick, curling up and hooking back on itself in one final snap before it goes still.
A stone well-crib seen from above, two pairs of timber beams crossing at right angles to frame a square opening down into the dark water.
A stiff figure jammed upright between two tall vertical bars, arms pinned to its sides, standing sentry exactly between them and blocking anyone from slipping through unnoticed.
A kneeling figure capped by a sharp triangular hood pulled low over the head, sealed and motionless, waiting rigid for the order to move.
A peaked attic roof capping a tight stack of bound ledger books beneath it, each cord-tied spine lined up in a neat row under the low ceiling.
A tall wooden post planted in the ground with a ringed target bolted near its top and an arrow jutting from the base, marking out a lord's private shooting range.
A heated turtle-shell splitting down the middle into two mirror-image crack lines curling away from each other, the fortune-teller leaning in to read the fracture.
A flat rectangular grain-basket woven tight and balanced on two short splayed legs, tipped slightly as if about to toss its contents to the wind.
A squat little stool with two splayed legs and one curved crossbar for a seat, low enough to trip over in a dim room.
A single triangular sail bellying out sideways from a mast planted on a low deck, catching wind and leaning the whole rig over.
A blade driven straight down into a block, the two halves springing apart to either side of it like a V cracked open by the cut.
A chisel blade held flush against the ridged edge of a cowrie shell, notching a fixed groove into it to set the standard everyone must match.
A parcel swaddled in brown paper, the wrapping folded clean around a curled-up shape tucked inside like a sleeping cat — corners tucked, string not yet tied.
Two western saloon doors swinging open at the same instant, one panel kicked left and one kicked right, perfectly mirrored and still rocking on their hinges.
A market peddler crouched low on one knee beside his cart, hauling a sack off the back and setting it down on the cobblestones to unload his wares for the wholesale buyers.
A hunched figure crouched low under a jagged rock ledge jutting out overhead, flinching and hugging their knees as loose gravel rains down from above.
A hand lunging forward at full stretch, fingers just closing around the fluttering coattail of someone sprinting away — the split-second catch-up, not quite past the wrist.
A short blade held flat above an open, shouting mouth like a megaphone cone, amplifying a summons that echoes out across a courtyard.
A heavy work boot stomping down squarely on a welcome mat in front of a doorway, heel first, as if announcing arrival at every single house on the street in turn.
A polished tray held up at chest height with both hands, a single gift box balanced dead-center on top, being presented forward to whoever stands waiting.
A drowsy figure with head cocked back at an angle, jaw dropped open in a wide unselfconscious yawn, one leg splayed out to the side for balance.
A jawbone knocked visibly off-center, hinging open at a lopsided angle so the mouth beneath it gapes crooked instead of straight.
A stone pedestal standing on a thick root-like base that splays into the ground, a small open mouth-shaped nameplate carved into its front face.
Two flat-topped tree stumps side by side in a clearing, a small figure perched cross-legged on each one, knees tucked, going nowhere.
A dense stack of sun-baked clay bricks piled narrow and tall, packed layer on layer with barely a gap, heavy and compressed from top to bottom.
A tin wind-up turtle with a domed shell lid on top and two little legs trailing out the back, clicking forward one step, pausing, then clicking the same step again.
A carved thumb-ring worn on a broad hand, one notch cut into its upper edge where the bowstring catches and releases.
A wooden yoke bar laid straight across a standing figure's shoulders, pinning them dead-center between its two ends like a crossbeam through a doorway.
A big lopsided head balanced on a small curved hook-shaped base, wobbling precariously off-kilter as if it might tip at any moment.
A large hand reaching in from the side, fingers closed around a kneeling marionette figure and tilting it forward by the shoulder.
A stiff hand poking out from beneath a low awning roof, gripping a short baton flat and level, tapping it against an invisible desk.
Two coiled wind socks mounted side by side on a low platform, both curling and twisting in the same gust like a matched pair of airport flags.
A wide bedsheet draped over a taut horizontal line, its top edge pinned flat to the crossbar and the rest hanging straight down in one heavy fold.
A long paved ramp leading up to a royal hall, a low rope-fence post planted right at its edge — officials in stiff robes shuffle up it in a single line toward the throne room.
Two parallel archer's bowstrings pulled taut side by side, each crossed by a short brace bar, humming with tension like they're refusing to be plucked.
Three fine diagonal comb-lines raked through wet hair (or paint), left to right, each stroke a touch shorter than the one above it.
A sharply-dressed young dandy with slicked hair, three rakish diagonal pinstripes combed across his brow like a signature flourish, strutting past a shop window to admire himself.
Two slender candle wicks standing side by side on a narrow ledge at the left edge of a scene, flames trembling as if the heart beneath them is beating.
A flat throwing-blade held motionless just above a visibly thudding heart, the wielder gritting his teeth and refusing to flinch as the point hovers a hair's breadth from skin.
A wide-eyed errand-boy sprinting flat-out with a basket clutched to his chest, elbows pumping, glancing back over his shoulder as if late for something urgent.
A man hunched under a broad hat-brim and heavy overcoat, head bowed low and feet dragging, trudging through drizzle with a slow, mournful shuffle.
A tall wooden pike planted upright in the dirt, a hooked side-blade jutting out partway down its shaft like a can-opener spur, catching the light.
A lone duelist plants one boot forward and hoists a hooked pike diagonally across his own chest in a boastful stance, as if declaring 'this one's mine.'
A sentry cups a hand to his ear to catch a distant shout, then relays it by tapping a code against his propped-up pike with a small mallet, message passed down the line.
A single wooden barn shutter hanging crooked on one hinge at the edge of a doorway, creaking slightly, half of a pair whose twin panel is missing.
A palace page-boy bowing low from the waist in respect, while behind him a tutor's cane is raised and about to tap his back to correct his posture.
A wide wooden comb with three evenly-spaced teeth laid flat on a tabletop, its teeth all trimmed to the exact same level, perfectly aligned.
A curved ladle dipping down into a round, glowing bowl of soup, tasting it before serving — the spoon poised directly above the sun-like disc.
A ship's anchor hooks down and drags a glowing sun beneath the flat line of the horizon, the light dimming as it's pulled under.
Two bamboo steamer baskets stacked one atop the other, their lattice vents crosshatched on top, steam rising from a pot base below.
A young fern's fiddlehead curls tightly off the side of a bare tree-like stalk, one extra spiral stroke twisting away from the trunk.
A closed fist grips the blunt butt-end of a long lance shaft, knuckles wrapped tight around the pole as if about to jab it forward.
A lumpy burlap sack has a straight metal rod driven clean through its middle, the rod's ends poking out on both sides like a shish-kebab skewer.
Two identical spoon-shaped silhouettes stand side by side facing the same way, mirror-image twins set shoulder to shoulder for comparison.
A single curling wisp of hair springs loose from a feather duster's head, coiling into a small hook shape as it catches the light.
A single stream of water splits and rejoins as it drops off a rock ledge, forking into forked rivulets that all braid back together at the bottom — one long unbroken cascade.
A robed figure mid-dance atop a four-legged iron grate, sleeves flung wide with wisps of grey ash trailing off each fingertip into nothing.
A hooked hawk's talon splayed downward, three curved claw-tips pressing into a branch from above.
A lean jackal crouched low at the left edge of a clearing, back arched and snout pointed forward, frozen mid-prowl.
A flat tin box with a horizontal stick of striped candy laid across its middle, lid open to show the treat sealed inside.
A small paper seedling-flag planted upright in a garden plot, its stem crossed by a horizontal marker-stick labeling the row.
A squat wine cask viewed from above, its round belly banded by a horizontal hoop and stoppered with a plug on top.
An animal hide half-peeled back from a carcass, one corner curling up under a skinning knife's dragging stroke.
A wide shallow platter standing on four stubby feet, its rim traced in one continuous unbroken line.
A robed priestess holding a dripping cut of meat in one hand above a stone altar table, lowering it as an offering at a festival.
A round-headed puppet with a painted face dangling on crossed strings above a wooden altar-stand, limbs splayed stiffly.
A tight knot of silk thread tied at the top with several loose strands hanging loose beneath it, swaying like a tassel.
A curly-horned ram standing rigidly atop a ceremonial standard, the banner's fringed pole planted beneath it like a war-flag — a solemn animal hoisted up as a symbol of honor.
A long-tailed pheasant perched with its two stiff wing-feathers fanned wide above its back, tail trailing down like a paintbrush dipped in ink.
A bent old man leaning hard on a walking stick, long wisps of hair trailing sideways from his bowed head as he shuffles forward.
Two stick-figure legs kicking outward in opposite directions from a shared hip, heels pointed away from each other like dance partners who can't agree on a step.
A narrow wooden dugout canoe riding low in the water, its hull carved from a single log with a small plank seat visible amidships.
A single rice seedling standing upright in the center of a flooded paddy field, its thin green blades poking up from the neat square plot of mud.
A red sun sinking flat into a thicket of tall grass at dusk, blades of reed closing over its glow from above and below like curtains falling.
A silk kimono draped over a wooden hanger, its wide sleeves spread open on either side and the collar folded into a soft V at the top.
A single folded lapel and sleeve-cuff pinned to the left edge of a tailor's dummy, a loose thread dangling — clothing reduced to its narrow corner swatch.
A long, heavy overcoat buttoned at the collar and hanging past the knees, its hem pooling in loose folds on the floor as if the wearer just stepped out of it.
A ridged antler sawn cleanly from a stag's skull, its rough segmented surface tapering to a sharp point at one corner.
Two steep snowy slopes angling down from a peak and meeting at a narrow notch, with a small dark gap opening at the very bottom where they converge — a valley pinched between two ridges.
A small squat ceremonial goblet: a flat round lid on top, a slim stem pinched in the middle, and two little legs splaying out at the wide flat base.
A long iron skewer rammed straight down through a stack of coin-purses, pinning them all together in one clean vertical line — the purses can't slide off no matter how hard you shake it.
A squat clay wine jug with a narrow corked neck and a bulging round belly, standing sealed on a cellar shelf, fermenting quietly in the dark.
A muddy badger paw-print stamped into soft ground, individual claw-marks fanned out and clearly separated from each other above the crossed pad-lines.
A tall heron standing one-legged in shallow water, two feathery tufts sticking straight up off its head like little exclamation marks, its narrow body tapering down to the waterline.
A raw animal hide pinned flat and taut across a wooden drying frame, stretched at every corner so it dries stiff and flat under the sun.
Two sandaled feet pacing in opposite directions around a walled outpost, one treading above it and one below, endlessly patrolling the same fixed enclosure.
A long horse's mane hanging down off an unseen neck, three loose strands combed out and swept back diagonally as if caught mid-gallop in the wind.
A ceremonial dancer wearing a broad flat jade pendant slung across the chest, arms and legs splayed out below it mid-step, the ornament catching a dull golden light.

A wooden cane whose handle curls into one long hooking stroke — sweeping down, then bending sharply back right along the baseline — with a small paper luggage tag looped and dangling from the top of the curl, its corner poking up-left like a short diagonal flick.

A street performer with his coat flung open at the collar (the splayed 八 V-strokes) and head thrown back in a wide, delighted grin, mouth gaping open as he belts out a tune over the heads of his crowd — braced on two planted legs like he's mid-bow after a coin lands.

Two squared timber ends cut with interlocking notches and dropped crosswise into each other, log-cabin style — the blunt square ends stack into a compact grid, and the visible notch-on-notch seam running through the middle is exactly the linking stroke that joins 冓's two lattice halves.
A small curled metal scoop, its handle hooking back over itself in a tight loop just like 勺's bent stroke, with a single sugar grain glinting as the dot caught inside the cup.
A knotted fist grinds and twists down into a lump of wet clay, wringing it round and round like dough — the fist's knuckly curve sits stacked directly above the flattened earthen lump it's working.

A wooden toy top standing upright: its wide, flared foot splays out at the bottom to balance on the floor, a stout spindle rises straight through the middle, and a small notched nub near the top marks where the string was last wound before the spin.

A disc mounted high on a pole with strands of beads dangling and swaying beneath it, like a doorway curtain hung from a hoop. The strands ripple and sway in a breeze, echoing 昜's wavy lower strokes spilling down from the flat 日 disc on top.
A crossed garrote cord is looped and cinched taut over a short execution post, the twisted X of wire biting into the wood at the top while two splayed legs of the post plant it firmly in the ground.

A small square notice pinned up high, with a crude sketched face filling its top half and a narrow strip of fine-print text tapering below it — a tiny printed likeness anyone would recognize at a glance.
